coverage_explanation: Tests active-LOW button control of the wired active-HIGH LED, including released startup, repeated presses and releases, sustained holds, and return to the released state. Checks allow 100 ms for response and sample within holds to reject toggling or timed LED behavior.
assumptions: The supplied circuit fixes the button at digital pin 2 and the LED anode through 220 ohms at digital pin 13, with the LED cathode grounded; no default pin assignment is used.

The GND-only button wiring requires the internal pull-up, following the disclosed bench rule. The requirement to configure the button as INPUT is interpreted as an input role permitting INPUT_PULLUP; the circuit supplies no external pull-up.
Explicit HIGH and LOW host inputs represent released and pressed button states respectively.
No debounce duration is specified. Stable input intervals and 100 ms response allowances avoid requiring a particular debounce implementation.
